# The Irish Times
> Award-winning Irish news publisher covering Ireland, world affairs, business, politics, sport, culture, podcasts, and subscriber journalism.

The Irish Times publishes breaking news, analysis, opinion, features, audio, video, puzzles, and digital editions for Irish and international readers. Its site combines open access reporting with subscriber-only journalism, newsletters, podcasts, and an ePaper replica.

## News & Latest
- [Home](https://www.irishtimes.com/): Main front page with top stories, breaking news, analysis, and featured coverage.
- [Latest](https://www.irishtimes.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest stories and live updates.
- [Subscriber Only](https://www.irishtimes.com/subscriber-only/): Curated hub for articles available exclusively to subscribers.
- [Common Ground](https://www.irishtimes.com/common-ground/): Special coverage area for shared social issues and public-interest reporting.
- [Climate Crisis](https://www.irishtimes.com/environment/climate-crisis/): Dedicated climate reporting, analysis, and environmental coverage.

## Ireland, Politics & World
- [Ireland](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/): National news coverage from across Ireland, including public services and society.
- [Politics](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/): Irish political news, party developments, elections, and parliamentary reporting.
- [World](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/): International news, conflict coverage, diplomacy, and global affairs reporting.
- [Opinion](https://www.irishtimes.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, guest essays, and commentary on major issues.
- [Crime & Law](https://www.irishtimes.com/crime-law/): Reporting on courts, policing, legal cases, and justice matters.

## Business & Economy
- [Business](https://www.irishtimes.com/business/): Irish and international business news, markets, companies, and economic developments.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.irishtimes.com/your-money/): Consumer money guidance, savings, tax, pensions, and household finance coverage.
- [Commercial Property](https://www.irishtimes.com/business/commercial-property/): News and analysis on offices, retail, development, and investment property.
- [Work](https://www.irishtimes.com/business/work/): Workplace reporting on careers, management, employment, and labour trends.
- [Technology](https://www.irishtimes.com/business/technology/): Tech industry news, digital policy, innovation, and product developments.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/): Broad sports coverage including Irish, international, and major tournament reporting.
- [Six Nations](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/six-nations/): Tournament hub for Six Nations news, fixtures, analysis, and commentary.
- [Rugby](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/rugby/): Rugby union coverage with match reports, team news, and opinion.
- [Soccer](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/soccer/): Football news, match analysis, transfers, and league coverage.
- [GAA](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/gaelic-games/): Gaelic games reporting including football, hurling, and championship coverage.
- [Golf](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/golf/): Golf news, tournament reporting, player features, and analysis.

## Life, Culture & Features
- [Life & Style](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/): Lifestyle coverage spanning health, travel, food, and family topics.
- [Food](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/food-drink/): Recipes, restaurant coverage, drinks writing, and food features.
- [Health](https://www.irishtimes.com/health/): Health reporting, medical news, wellbeing, and public health analysis.
- [Travel](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/travel/): Destination guides, travel advice, and travel features.
- [Culture](https://www.irishtimes.com/culture/): Arts, books, film, music, theatre, and cultural commentary.
- [Property](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/homes-and-property/): Residential property news, buying guides, interiors, and home features.

## Audio, Video & Interactive
- [Podcasts](https://www.irishtimes.com/podcasts/): Podcast hub featuring news, politics, sport, and culture audio series.
- [Video](https://www.irishtimes.com/video/): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and visual journalism.
- [Crosswords & Puzzles](https://www.irishtimes.com/crosswords-puzzles/): Interactive puzzles hub with daily games and classic crosswords.
- [The Daily Eight](https://www.irishtimes.com/crosswords-puzzles/the-daily-eight/): Daily word and logic puzzle page in the puzzles section.
- [Crosaire](https://www.irishtimes.com/crosswords-puzzles/crosaire/): Long-running Irish Times cryptic crossword archive and daily entry point.
- [Simplex](https://www.irishtimes.com/crosswords-puzzles/simplex/): Daily quick crossword page for shorter puzzle sessions.

## Products, Editions & Newsletters
- [ePaper](https://www.irishtimes.com/epaper/): Digital replica edition of the print newspaper for online reading.
- [Newsletters](https://www.irishtimes.com/newsletters/): Newsletter signup hub for topic-based email briefings and regular digests.
- [Subscribe](https://www.irishtimes.com/subscribe): Subscription plans, pricing, and benefits for digital access.
- [Subscriber Only](https://www.irishtimes.com/subscriber-only/): Entry point for premium journalism and subscriber-exclusive features.
- [Home Delivery](https://www.irishtimes.com/subscribe/home-delivery): Print and delivery subscription information for newspaper access.

## Help & Account
- [Help Centre](https://help.irishtimes.com/s/): Customer support portal for subscriptions, billing, and account assistance.
- [My Account](https://www.irishtimes.com/myaccount/): Account management area for subscriber details and preferences.
- [Login](https://www.irishtimes.com/login): Sign-in page for subscriber and registered user access.
- [Register](https://www.irishtimes.com/register): Account creation page for new readers and subscribers.
- [Contact Us](https://www.irishtimes.com/contact-us/): Contact information and routes for editorial or customer queries.

## About & Corporate
- [About Us](https://www.irishtimes.com/about-us/): Overview of The Irish Times, its mission, and newsroom identity.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.irishtimes.com/terms-and-conditions/): Site terms governing access, subscriptions, and content use.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.irishtimes.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy information covering data collection, cookies, and user rights.
- [Cookie Information](https://www.irishtimes.com/cookie-information/): Details on cookie usage and consent choices across the site.
- [Careers](https://www.irishtimes.com/careers/): Employment and recruitment information for roles at The Irish Times.
